device.none: No devices yet. Tap + to add one.

settings.tz_hint: Daylight saving time is handled automatically. Enter schedule times in local time — the app converts to UTC for the feeder. Change takes effect after feeder reconnects.
settings.ha_bell_hint: Posts alerts to the Home Assistant notification bell.
settings.email_hint: Email-capable HA notify service (Gmail, SMTP, etc.). Select one to enable email alerts.
settings.email_to_hint: Fallback address used when a device has no email override set.
settings.mobile_hint: Default HA mobile_app service. Used when a device has Mobile enabled but no per-device service set.
settings.mqtt_hint: The add-on connects to this broker to receive device data. Create a dedicated broker user in Mosquitto for the add-on.
settings.local_audio_base_url_hint: A plain LAN address for this add-on, not the Home Assistant ingress link. Feeders fetch custom sounds directly over the network, they can't use your logged-in browser session. Required before you can push a custom sound to a feeder.
settings.audio_library_hint: Shared across all feeders. Push any of these to a specific feeder from its Maintenance tab.
settings.audio_library_empty: No sounds yet. Upload a file or record one below.
settings.audio_library_load_failed: Could not load the sound library.
settings.audio_delete_confirm: Delete "{name}"? Any feeder currently using it will keep playing it until a new sound is pushed.
settings.audio_record_insecure: Recording needs HTTPS (or localhost) to access your microphone. Home Assistant reached over plain HTTP can't do this — use Upload File instead.
settings.audio_upload_hint: Any common audio format works (MP3, WAV, M4A, etc.), it's converted automatically. Recording needs HTTPS or localhost access to your browser's microphone, which most home setups reached over plain HTTP don't have, Upload File works everywhere and is the reliable option.
settings.audio_record_empty: No audio was captured. Your browser may not support recording in this format, try a longer recording or use Upload File instead.
settings.mqtt_fail: ✗ MQTT connection failed — check host, port, username, and password

maint.min_drink_hint: 5g ≈ 1 tsp. Lower for kittens or small sips; raise if pump movement triggers false readings.
maint.feed_sounds_hint: Experimental. Push a custom sound clip to this feeder to play instead of the default chime. Requires Local Audio Base URL to be set in Settings.

about.title: Help / About
about.debug_capture_hint: Downloads a rolling log of recent raw device MQTT traffic, including any device this app doesn't recognize (marked UNRECOGNIZED). Collected continuously in the background, so it also catches devices that only check in occasionally. WiFi name and any local audio server URL are redacted, but this file still includes your device serial numbers, so please email it to github@mega-city.com rather than posting it publicly when reporting an unsupported or misbehaving device.
